scope: Evidence obligations mapped to #165; not an exhaustive issue census or a claim that later work elsewhere has not satisfied an obligation.

items.closure_evidence_required: Establish shell assumptions at every committed runtime boundary; run hostile predecessor, authority, callback and speech tests.
Predeclare component subtractions and compensating compositions; compare capability, cost and invariant failures.

items.obligation: Small domain-general controller across added domains
items.closure_evidence_required: Measure source/branch growth and prior-information additions; reject hidden domain-specific controller shortcuts.
FC-T2 and focused oracle comparisons supplied; independent review still required.

items.obligation: Integrated indexed revocation and durable lifecycle
items.closure_evidence_required: Bind index epochs to actual transactions; shadow compare existing engine; test restart, interrupted commit, rollback and state migration before serving adoption.

items.obligation: Candidate discovery beyond primitive alias and compression
items.closure_evidence_required: New prospectively registered mechanism or scoped negative terminal; no outcome-conditioned reuse of exposed validation/test families.
Admission before task access, process restart, semantic task disjointness, actual invocation trace and registered benefit.

items.obligation: Causal method removal and support revocation
items.closure_evidence_required: Matched separately owned snapshots, live/removed/revoked/placebo arms, exact withdrawal and useful-effect contrast.
Give conventional parent identical primitives, learned object, information, checker and budgets; separate acquisition effect from architecture effect.

items.obligation: Generative composition of separately learned methods
items.closure_evidence_required: Freeze unseen A+B tasks; verify use of both identities; ablate A, B and both; charge composition search/checking.

items.obligation: Scoped failure learning without impossibility laundering
items.closure_evidence_required: Store method/state/budget/environment scope; reduce compatible repeated failures without blocking changed-regime successes; compare TMS/nogood parent.
Finite congruence reference supplied; integrate certificate invalidation and register full lifecycle action alphabet before deployment.

items.obligation: Diagnose insufficiency rather than inferring it from timeout
items.closure_evidence_required: Separate missing evidence/operator/channel, search effort and resource bound through registered discriminators.
Conditional information bound, prior side information and cost channel must be justified in each real diagnostic ecology.

items.obligation: Repair cost from probability and checking work
items.closure_evidence_required: Use measured candidate/test cost models; entropy is a descriptor, not a search-cost guarantee.
Verify common optimal continuation action or solve registered finite metareasoning comparison; count policy computation.
Keep exact-policy-sufficient terminal; new legal-state variation, identifiable residual, stronger exact parents and net lifecycle benefit are required.
Measure build, useful horizon, drift, maintenance, checking, revocation, replay and parent costs at predeclared prices.

items.obligation: Physical Pareto benefit at matched capability
items.closure_evidence_required: Measure physical compute, wall time, I/O, storage and peak memory; logical incidence/search counts alone do not close this claim.

items.obligation: Learned self-model identifiability and repair searchability
items.closure_evidence_required: Use real non-oracle failure channels, interacting/redundant causes, misleading self-models, direct empirical/probabilistic parents and paid interventions.

items.obligation: Governed shadow search and external adoption
items.closure_evidence_required: Isolated non-authoritative branches, no protected feedback, complete archive costs, fresh external gates and rollback/reopening tests.
Prospective checkpoint comparison with self-history removal and matched repair parent; measure information/search/cost rather than only rising task score.
Bind each checkpoint to exact predecessor and inherited state; prohibit independent per-domain resets being called one lifetime.
Frozen donor/receiver tasks, transfer-scope correctness, reset and same-library controls, negative transfer, retention and primitive-pressure accounting.

items.obligation: Bounded conversational and scientific proof of function
items.closure_evidence_required: Fresh actual-speech and task execution evaluation; trace understanding to warranted commitment; no hidden frontier-model substitution in mechanism arm.
Combine relevant conventional components with matched data, tools, memory, verifier, information and full lifetime costs.
Semantic task identity, matched warm state, separate-owned counterfactual arms and full lifecycle measurements.

items.obligation: Protected evaluation with valid repeated looks
items.closure_evidence_required: Independent lifetime units or justified conditional model, prospective K/outcomes/bounds and global error budget across challenger proposals.
Evaluator independent of mechanism/test author, protected outcomes unavailable during design, independently reconstructed artifacts and uncertainty analysis.
Fresh protected M11/M12 evidence and successor custody; engineering replay is not renewed scientific admission.
Resolve the declared gated thesis with supported, conditional, parent-sufficient or negative scope; do not replace evidence with a documentation-completion label.
